thread:
james.h: Hey team — RailTech POC kickoff this week. Quick summary from the customer: SSO via SAML (Okta), SCIM user sync (delta support + bulk import fallback), domain proofing across 3 domains (they want delegated ownership), RBAC mapping from IdP groups -> our workspace roles, and they flagged data residency + FIPS KMS for Private deployment. Pricing question up front: if they start on Hosted and transition to Dedicated in Q2, what does the uplift / migration support look like? They also asked for an ACS/EntityID to give to their Okta admin and SCIM rate limit guidance.

sarah.se: OK — we can handle all of that. Short answers first:
- SAML: we provide an SP metadata blob (ACS + EntityID) and support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows.
- SCIM: delta sync + bulk CSV import supported; we have exponential backoff for 429s and a resumable bulk job for initial provisioning.
- Domain proofing: support DNS TXT verification per domain or admin delegation via SAML claims.
- RBAC: mapping table can be configured to map Okta group names to workspace roles; we also support attribute-based mapping if they prefer.

sarah.se: Here is the SP metadata snippet you can give their Okta admin:
```
AssertionConsumerService: https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs
EntityID: https://redwood.example.com/saml/metadata
NameIDFormat: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
SignedResponse: true
```

sarah.se: For SCIM, tell them to expect default rate limit 60 requests/min for Hosted; Dedicated can increase that with a config. SCIM attributes we accept by default:
```
userName
name.givenName
name.familyName
emails[type=work]
active
groups (SCIM group membership)
externalId
```
We also include an idempotent bulk endpoint: POST /scim/v2/Bulk with CSV or list payloads.

alex-sales: Pricing / migration notes for the contract team:
- Hosted: pay-as-you-go per-token + per-embedding; quick time-to-value, no infra commitment.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU capacity. Typical uplift is ~2.5x of equivalent hosted unit cost for reserved throughput but with predictable latency and cheaper tail cost for heavy sustained usage. Discounts vary by commit term (3/12/36 month tiers).
- Migration: we provide a migration playbook + 8 hours of SE support included for mid-market deals; enterprise migration (onsite/air-gapped or Private) is scoped as professional services.

mike-security: They will want to see:
- SOC 2 Type II report
- Pen test summary and vulnerability disclosure process
- Data residency and KMS options (we support customer-managed keys in Private)
- SCIM provisioning security: TLS mutual auth option, and audit logs for provisioning events
- Clarify session timeout and SAML assertion lifetime defaults (we send default AssertionValidity = 5m, but configurable)

mike-security: Also flagging RBAC edge-case: if they plan nested groups in Okta we should confirm whether they expect transitive membership — our mapping supports transitive but we need to confirm performance implications for very large orgs.

james.h: Helpful, thanks. Action items I can take now:
1) Send SP metadata snippet to their Okta admin (will DM contact).
2) Ask them for expected user count and provisioning cadence so Sarah can propose SCIM rate limits and bulk job windows.
3) Loop in legal for the SOC2/pen test docs and ask for timeline on security questionnaire.
4) Ask whether they want hosted first or require Dedicated/Private from day 1 due to data residency.

sarah.se: I'll draft a SCIM onboarding checklist + sample mapping file and drop it into the deal. Also will propose a default RBAC mapping and a performance note for nested groups.

alex-sales: I'll prepare a short pricing addendum showing Hosted vs Dedicated with a sample 6-month migration path and ballpark PS estimate for Private/FIPS KMS.

deploy-bot: Reminder: POC kickoff meeting scheduled in 48 hours with RailTech (calendar invite sent).

james.h: Great — thumbs up from me. @sarah.se please attach the SCIM sample today and @mike-security we may need a brief security sync before EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
